_comment: Slack app manifest for the LOS Loan Tools MCP server. Create the app at api.slack.com/apps with Create New App, From a manifest. The OAuth client ID, client secret, authorization URL, token URL, and PKCE setting are entered afterwards under Features, MCP Servers (docs/CLIENT-SETUP.md, For admins); they are never committed here. Replace the URL if the org is a sandbox or scratch org (sandbox/ after v1/).
